title: Complimentary Waiver by Price Type of the Purchase — Marlowe & Finch Alterations Decision Table
content:
On a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket, the complimentary waiver takes exactly one of three forms, set by the price type of the purchase record the ticket names in Merchandise Purchases and, for a sale-price purchase, by the customer's Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership.

| Purchase named on the ticket | Customer | Complimentary form and what it waives |
|---|---|---|
| at regular price | any | whole-charge form: the whole operation charge |
| at sale price | active member at Finch Circle Gold or above (a tier whose qualifying spend threshold is 1200.00 USD or more) | allowance form: the lesser of the operation charge and the member's sale-work allowance |
| at sale price | anyone else | no-waiver form: nothing |
| at clearance, doorbuster or final sale price | any | no-waiver form: nothing |

**Records read.** The price type on the Merchandise Purchases record named on the ticket; the tier and status of the customer's Finch Circle membership.

## Hypothetical cases (allowance figures chosen for illustration)

| Price type | Active member at Gold or above | Operation charge | Member's sale-work allowance | Waiver |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| regular | no | 24.00 USD | — | 24.00 USD |
| sale | yes | 24.00 USD | 10.00 USD | 10.00 USD |
| sale | yes | 18.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 18.00 USD (the lesser) |
| sale | no | 24.00 USD | — | nothing |
| clearance | yes | 24.00 USD | — | nothing |
